notes.purpose: The tactical fine-tune (docs/eval/finetune-tactical/PLAN.md): ours-tactical continues from ours-freeze (--init) on the tactical views' tiles of dataset tactical's 120 training clips. Every training setting equals finetune-v2freeze.json; only the time cap differs. Set before any clip was rendered.
notes.time_cap: 150 minutes: about 4 times ours-freeze's images (30 minutes on a 4090), so the run may stop at the cap; it then keeps its best validation checkpoint and its manifest says it was stopped.
